title: Population and Housing Census
description: Population, households and demographic tables.
known_limitations: No release approved; small-area tables and reuse terms require assessment.

title: National Accounts
description: GDP, growth and economic structure.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: Gross County Product
description: County economic output and structure.
known_limitations: Must not be allocated to constituencies or wards.

title: Consumer Price Indices and Inflation Rates
description: National and published regional price indices and inflation.
known_limitations: Price regions must not be relabelled as electoral geographies.

title: Monetary and Financial Statistics
description: Exchange rates, policy rates and Treasury market indicators.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: Electoral Geography Register
description: Counties, constituencies and County Assembly Wards.
known_limitations: Hierarchy complete; machine-readable geometry and record spelling remain pending direct official validation.

title: Registered Voters
description: Published voter-register totals by electoral geography.
known_limitations: Reference register date is mandatory; no release approved.

title: County Budget Implementation
description: County revenue, expenditure, absorption and pending bills.
known_limitations: PDF extraction and definitions require release-level review.

title: Agricultural Market Prices
description: Commodity prices and volumes by published market.
known_limitations: Market identifiers, units and access terms require assessment.

title: Communications Sector Statistics
description: Mobile, broadband, internet and related sector indicators.
known_limitations: Subnational coverage varies.

title: Energy and Petroleum Statistics
description: Energy access, electricity and petroleum indicators.
known_limitations: No release approved.

title: National Fiscal Publications
description: Budget, debt, transfers and fiscal framework.
known_limitations: Definitions and vintages require reconciliation.

title: Public Health Statistics
description: Approved aggregate health indicators.
known_limitations: Privacy, suppression and access conditions not assessed.

title: Public Education Statistics
description: Approved aggregate education indicators.
known_limitations: Privacy, suppression and machine-readable availability not assessed.

title: National Assembly Constituencies and County Assembly Wards Order
description: Controlling legal description of constituency and ward names and boundaries.
known_limitations: Machine-readable geometry is not supplied by the Atlas from this document.

title: Community Geography Cross-checks
description: Pinned public transcriptions and extracts retained for validation and discrepancy analysis.
known_limitations: External; not official and not sufficient alone for authoritative geometry.

title: 2019 Census — Topline Population Counts
description: Enumerated total population from the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, national and county level headline counts only.
known_limitations: Topline enumerated counts only (point-in-time, census night 24-25 August 2019). Does not include age/sex/household breakdowns, sub-county or ward figures. The full census dataset (DS-KNBS-CENSUS, all volumes and small-area tables) remains blocked pending broader assessment; this narrower slice was reviewed and approved separately because a headline count carries none of that dataset's reuse or small-area risk.

title: Headline Consumer Price Inflation (Monthly, National)
description: Year-on-year headline consumer price inflation rate, national level, as published monthly by KNBS.
known_limitations: Headline year-on-year rate only. Sub-indices (food, transport, housing), the full CPI basket, and county/urban-rural breakdowns remain out of scope (see DS-KNBS-CPI, blocked). Index rebasing is a known future series break; see docs/methodology/indicators.md.

title: Central Bank Rate, 91-Day Treasury Bill Yield and USD/KES Reference Rate
description: Headline monetary policy and reference-rate figures: the Central Bank Rate as set by the Monetary Policy Committee, the 91-day Treasury bill weighted average yield from CBK auction results, and a USD/KES reference rate.
known_limitations: Headline rates only; broader monetary and financial statistics (DS-CBK-MONETARY: banking sector, balance of payments, monetary aggregates) remain blocked. The USD/KES figure in this dataset is a market mid-rate corroborated across multiple FX data aggregators on the reference date, not CBK's own published indicative rate (which was not directly retrieved); it is recorded with geographic_method=direct but statistical_status=estimated and an external source_url, and is badged accordingly rather than as an official CBK release.

title: Registered Voters — National Topline (Certified Register)
description: The certified, audited national total of registered voters as of the 2022 General Election, from IEBC's Post-Election Evaluation Report.
known_limitations: Certified national topline as of the 2022 General Election register cutoff (20 June 2022) only. Constituency- and ward-level breakdowns and the ongoing continuous-registration count toward 2027 remain out of scope (see DS-IEBC-VOTERS, blocked, and the ward-level electoral unlock strategy in the product spec).

title: 2019 Census — Official County Land Area
description: Official county and national land-area figures from the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census.
known_limitations: County/national land area only. Does not provide electoral-constituency or ward areas. RCMRD is retained as a spatial boundary cross-check, not the numeric area authority.

title: Constituency and Ward Area (derived from validated boundary geometry)
description: Approximate small-area size computed from the Atlas validated boundary geometry; county headline area is instead sourced directly from KNBS 2019.
known_limitations: Not a surveyed or official area figure. Used only where the official KNBS county land-area table does not publish the electoral geography. Geometry is externally validated and area is an approximation with the documented error band; county values are no longer sourced from this dataset.

title: Maximum Retail Fuel Prices — Super Petrol (Nairobi, Mombasa)
description: Monthly maximum retail pump price of Super Petrol for the Nairobi and Mombasa pricing towns, as announced by EPRA under the Petroleum Act 2019 and Legal Notice No. 192 of 2022.
known_limitations: Covers only 2 of 47 counties (Nairobi and Mombasa pricing towns) from a single announcement. EPRA sets prices by town/pricing zone, not strictly by administrative county boundary; Nairobi town and Mombasa town are used here as reasonable proxies for their respective counties, not as an official county-level statistic. The remaining EPRA town price list (34+ towns) is not yet loaded. Diesel and kerosene prices from the same announcement are not yet loaded either.

title: World Development Indicators — Kenya social indicators
description: National social indicators for Kenya retrieved from the World Bank WDI API.
known_limitations: National only. Includes harmonised, projected and modelled series. Values must not be relabelled as county, constituency or ward statistics. Population projection is distinct from KNBS census enumeration.

title: World Development Indicators — Kenya economic indicators
description: National economic indicators for Kenya retrieved from the World Bank WDI API.
known_limitations: National only. WDI harmonisation can differ from KNBS/CBK definitions and vintages. WB annual inflation is background context and must not displace the monthly KNBS headline. Remittances are held from activation pending primary-source CBK treatment.

title: World Development Indicators — Kenya environment and infrastructure indicators
description: National environment, infrastructure and service-access indicators for Kenya retrieved from the World Bank WDI API.
known_limitations: National only. Access-to-electricity can be linked to a Kenyan series only when the Kenyan alternate is active and genuinely comparable.

title: World Development Indicators — Kenya institutions indicators
description: National institutional, digital, public-safety, representation and investment indicators for Kenya retrieved from the World Bank WDI API.
known_limitations: National only. Composite/index indicators require explicit methodology disclosure. Internet-use alternates must not be linked to Communications Authority data until a CA series is actually ingested.

title: Kenya Poverty Report 2022 — County Overall Poverty Headcount
description: County overall individual poverty headcount estimates from the 2022 Kenya Continuous Household Survey, including source-reported standard errors.
known_limitations: Survey estimates. P04 publishes county point estimates with source-reported standard errors but withholds league-table ranking; 2022 reference period must remain visible.

title: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022 — Selected County Indicators
description: Selected 2022 KDHS county estimates for child nutrition, basic immunisation and skilled birth attendance, with the source table denominator retained as precision metadata.
known_limitations: Survey estimates from distinct analytic universes. Reported table denominators are retained; P04 withholds point-estimate county ranking pending P06 comparison methodology.

title: Kenya Health Facility Census 2023 — County Facilities Assessed
description: County counts of health facilities assessed in the 2023 Ministry of Health Health Facility Census.
known_limitations: Dated August–September 2023 census assessment snapshot, not a live 2026 KMHFR/NHFR registry total. Raw counts are not population-adjusted and are not ranked in P04.

title: Presidential Working Party on Education Reform 2023 — TSC County Establishments
description: County public primary and secondary school establishments and TSC teacher establishments from Appendices 4.5 and 4.6.
known_limitations: Public-school and TSC establishment counts only; not all public/private schools or all education workers.

title: Gross County Product 2025 release — 2024 Economic Activity
description: County agriculture and manufacturing gross value added at current prices from the 2024 GCP economic-activity annex.
known_limitations: Current-price sector values and shares describe economic structure, not welfare or county-government performance.

title: National Agriculture Production Report 2024 — 2023 Maize by County
description: County maize area and production for 2023 from Annex 1; Atlas yield is transparent arithmetic from the same source row.
known_limitations: 2023 crop production snapshot. Yield is an Atlas-derived ratio of reported production tonnes to reported area hectares.

title: 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey — County Connectivity and Main-grid Electricity
description: County internet use, computer use and household connection to main-grid electricity from the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey data tables.
known_limitations: Survey reference period 2023/24. Internet/computer measures are for individuals aged 3+; main-grid electricity is a household measure and must not be conflated with the individual denominator.

title: 2009 Census — County Population Counts
description: Official 2009 census population totals for all 47 counties.
known_limitations: Official county totals only; no allocation below county.

title: Registered Voters — 2022 County Gazette Schedule
description: IEBC Gazette Third Schedule registered-voter totals for all 47 counties.
known_limitations: County Gazette schedule totals 22,102,532; the later audited national topline is a different release vintage.

title: Gross County Product 2025 — Current Prices
description: Gross County Product at current prices for all 47 counties, 2020–2024.
known_limitations: 2024 is preliminary. County values must not be allocated below county.

title: County Budget Implementation — FY 2024/25
description: County budget, expenditure and absorption measures for FY 2024/25.
known_limitations: County fiscal-year totals and absorption rates only.

title: Super Petrol — Representative EPRA Pricing Towns, Aug–Sep 2026
description: Published Super Petrol pricing-town observations linked to counties for navigation.
known_limitations: Pricing-town observations, not county averages. Nyandarua uses the nearest published pricing town, Nyahururu.

title: Headline Inflation — Historical Monthly Series
description: Historical national headline year-on-year CPI inflation, monthly.
known_limitations: Headline year-on-year rate only. Historical values may span CPI rebasing regimes; values are reproduced as published and are not recomputed across base changes.

title: Central Bank Rate — Historical Decision Series
description: Historical Central Bank Rate observations from the official CBK CBR table.
known_limitations: Policy-rate decision observations only; unchanged intervals are not expanded to daily or monthly rows.

title: USD/KES — Monthly Period-Average Exchange Rate
description: Official CBK monthly period-average Kenya shillings per US dollar.
known_limitations: Monthly period averages are a separate measure from the Atlas daily market-mid reference series and must not be merged into that daily series.

title: 91-Day Treasury Bill — Historical Monthly Average
description: Official CBK monthly 91-day Treasury bill rate history from the central-bank-rates table and Statistical Bulletins.
known_limitations: Monthly average series; it is distinct from individual weekly auction observations.

title: Super Petrol — Nairobi Pricing-Town History
description: Historical maximum retail Super Petrol price for the Nairobi EPRA pricing town.
known_limitations: Nairobi pricing-town observations only. These are not Nairobi County averages and are never propagated to other geographies.

title: County Budget Implementation — Historical Annual Series
description: Annual county budget, expenditure and absorption measures from Controller of Budget annual reports.
known_limitations: Official county fiscal-year values only. No allocation to constituencies or wards. Definitions are preserved from each annual report.

title: Rent burden by county — 2024
description: County total-column proportion of rent to household expenditure from KNBS Economic Survey 2025 Table 20.5.
known_limitations: Rent-burden measure only; not a synthetic cost-of-living index or prediction of an individual household rent.

title: Housing tenure by county — 2021
description: County household tenure status from the KNBS Kenya Time Use Survey 2021 Table 3.6b.
known_limitations: Tenure status is not itself a measure of housing quality, affordability or household wealth.

title: Kenya Health Facility Census target stock — 2023
description: County target-facility stock used for the 2023 Kenya Health Facility Census, based on the KMHFL list as at 1 August 2023.
known_limitations: Facility-stock/supply context only; does not measure travel time, service quality, capacity or personal access.

title: School attendance status by county — 2019 census
description: County school-attendance status from Appendix 2.2 of the KNBS 2019 KPHC Analytical Report on Education and Training.
known_limitations: Attendance status, not learning quality or attainment. County age structure affects comparisons.

title: Labour-force participation by county — 2019 census
description: County total labour-force participation rate for ages 15–64 from KNBS 2019 KPHC Labour Force Table 3.19.
known_limitations: Labour-force participation is not unemployment, job quality, earnings or probability of finding work.

title: 2025 Budget Review and Outlook Paper — County OSR Target Attainment
description: FY2024/25 county own-source revenue target-attainment percentages published by the National Treasury using Controller of Budget data.
known_limitations: Full-year own-source revenue including FIF/AiA divided by the published target. Values are retained at the whole-percentage precision published in the 2025 BROP; no missing county is estimated or interpolated.

title: County Executive audit opinions, FY2023/24
description: Categorical audit opinion for each of Kenya’s 47 County Executives from Appendix 1(a) of the Auditor-General summary report for FY2023/24.
known_limitations: The observation is the categorical audit opinion only. It is not converted to a numeric performance score or ranking.

title: 2019 KPHC — Average Household Size by County
description: Average household size for all 47 counties, transcribed from KNBS 2019 KPHC Volume I Table 2.3.
known_limitations: 2019 census snapshot. KNBS Table 2.3 excludes the special population from the conventional-household denominator; no current-year interpolation is made.
